text: An expedition is a trip with a goal, like exploring a place or finding something out. This expedition was a trip on a ship to send a robot to the bottom of the ocean.
To examine something is to look at it very carefully to learn about it. The scientists examined the animals to see if any were new.
Transparent means clear, so you can see through it, like a window. This sea cucumber is almost clear, so you can nearly see through its body.
A research ship is a boat built for science. Scientists live and work on it while they study the ocean.
A remotely operated vehicle is a machine that people drive from far away. Nobody rides inside it. People on the ship steered SuBastian with controls connected to it by a long cable.
SuBastian is the name of the underwater robot. It carried cameras and arms down to the seafloor.
A canyon is a deep valley with steep sides, like a giant crack in the ground. This canyon is under the ocean.
The Grand Canyon is a famous, very deep canyon in Arizona, in the United States. The canyon under the ocean is more than twice as deep.
Argentina is a country in South America. Its coast is on the Atlantic Ocean.
The Atlantic Ocean is the big ocean between the Americas on one side and Europe and Africa on the other.
A valley is low land between hills or mountains. An underwater valley is the same shape, but it is on the ocean floor.
The seafloor is the bottom of the ocean, the ground under all the water.
Sediment is sand, mud, and tiny bits of rock that settle at the bottom of water. Lauretta first saw only soft mud on the seafloor.
Here dove means went down under the water. It is not the bird called a dove. The robot went down to the bottom 17 times.
A coral reef is a big structure under the sea built by tiny animals called corals. Many fish and other animals live around it.
A sea star, also called a starfish, is a sea animal shaped like a star, usually with five arms. It is not a fish.
Findings are the things people find out or discover. The findings of this trip were all the animals and pictures the robot brought back.
To announce something is to tell everyone about it. The team told the world they had found new animals.
To identify something is to figure out what it is. The team figured out that 57 of the animals were new.
Marine means living in the sea or having to do with the sea. Marine species are kinds of sea animals and plants.
A species is one kind of living thing. All house cats are one species, and all lions are another. A new species is a kind nobody had described before.
A researcher is a person whose job is to study something carefully to learn new facts about it.
This is a science museum in Argentina. Scientists there study animals, plants, and rocks, not only show them to visitors.
Buenos Aires is the capital and biggest city of Argentina.
The Schmidt Ocean Institute is a group that runs science trips to explore the ocean. It owns the ship and the robot.
Streamed means sent over the internet so people can watch it right away. Anyone online could watch what the robot's cameras saw.
To tune in means to start watching or listening to a show. Millions of people watched the robot's video.
Nothing really blew up. The chat is where viewers type messages, and it exploded means a huge number of messages showed up very fast.
A resemblance is how much one thing looks like another. People said the sea star looked a lot like Patrick Star.
Patrick Star is the pink starfish who is SpongeBob's best friend in the cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants.
A taxonomist is a scientist who sorts living things into groups and gives them names. They are the ones who decide if an animal is a new species.
A detective is a person who looks for clues to solve a mystery. Scientists look for clues in an animal's body to learn if it is new.
A sea cucumber is a soft sea animal with a long body shaped a bit like a cucumber. It lives on the seafloor. It is an animal, not a plant.
An expert is someone who knows a lot about one subject. Solís-Marín knows a lot about sea cucumbers.
Loki is a character in Marvel movies and comics who wears a helmet with horns. The bumpy sea cucumber got his name as a nickname.
Copepods are tiny sea animals, smaller than a grain of rice. Many fish and whales eat them.
A crustacean is an animal with a hard shell on the outside of its body, like a crab, a shrimp, or a lobster.
Samples are small amounts taken to study. The robot scooped up mud and animals so scientists could look at them in the lab.
A tenth is one part out of ten equal parts. The scientists have looked at only 1 out of every 10 of their copepod samples so far.
Official means real and approved, the way it is supposed to be. A nickname like Loki is just for fun, and the official name is the one scientists agree on.
A scientific name is the name scientists everywhere use for one species, written in Latin words. For example, a house cat's scientific name is Felis catus.
A nickname is an extra, friendly name, not the real one. Loki is the sea cucumber's nickname.
A reward is something good you get for doing hard work. The scientists' reward is getting to choose the new animal's name.
Peniagone is the name of the group of sea cucumbers that Loki belongs to. The sp. means its own species name has not been chosen yet.
